sheet_prompt:
One illustration of 9 separate characters arranged in 3 rows of 3, evenly spaced across a single seamless background.
Subject: A young Emirati girl wearing a traditional black abaya and shayla, expressive face, standing in various poses in a 3x3 grid..
Style: kawaii chibi style, big shiny eyes, tiny body and an oversized head, pastel colours, soft blush cheeks, very cute and rounded.
Outline: none. Draw every character directly on the background with no outline, border, stroke, die-cut edge or halo around it.
Reading left to right, top to bottom, every character is a different moment: a wide range of emotions AND different states of action (standing, walking, running, jumping, sitting, lying down, leaning, reaching, spinning), so no two characters share a pose, a body position or a silhouette:
Character 1: joyfully jumping with arms wide open, big smile showing happiness
Character 2: sitting calmly cross-legged with eyes closed, peaceful and serene
Character 3: leaning forward curiously with a tilted head, eager to listen
Character 4: standing proudly with hands on hips, chest out with confidence
Character 5: running energetically with arms pumping and wide smile
Character 6: sitting on knees, shyly glancing sideways with blushing cheeks
Character 7: lying on side, propped on elbow, smiling mischievously
Character 8: spinning happily with a carefree laugh and arms extended
Character 9: standing stiffly with wide eyes and hands raised in shock
Make every expression big and readable at small size: exaggerated eyes, eyebrows, mouth and body language.
Consistency: the same character design, proportions and colours for all 9 characters.
Background: a single, seamless, solid pure green (#00FF00) background covering the whole image in exactly one shade, with no tiled panels, no shading variations, no tint, gradient, vignette or glow, no shadows, no floor, no noise.
Spacing: every character is full body with a generous empty margin on every side (at least 20% of its own size), clearly separated from the others, none touching or crossing another.
video_prompt:
Animate this 3x3 sheet of characters as a 3-second clip.
Create a very expressive animation of each character, each having its own personality with a wide range of emotions.
1. bounces gently up and down with joyful energy
2. subtle breathing with slight head nod indicating calmness
3. slow gentle lean and head tilt back and forth
4. slight chest puff and head held high with pride
5. fast arm and leg movement simulating running
6. small shy head turns and subtle blush animation
7. slow playful head wiggle and cheeky smile
8. continuous slow spin with laughing expression
9. shaking slightly with startled blinking
Each character moves only inside its own cell. Empty cells stay empty. Static camera.
Keep the flat green background and every character's design unchanged.
